inclusion: participants pre-selected for elevated eating disorder symptoms, as established through either a formal diagnostic interview confirming a threshold or subthreshold diagnosis, scores above a validated cutoff on a standardized rating scale, or endorsement of eating disorder behaviors (eg, >=3 objective binge episodes)
exclusion: Unselected samples, or those screened solely for risk factors (eg, weight concerns) without the presence of eating disorder symptoms

inclusion: Digital interventions for eating disorders (defined as interventions delivered via a computer, mobile phone, or tablet, where the means of delivery included the internet, downloadable software, CD-ROM, smartphone application, or chatbot; professional or peer support was permitted)
exclusion: therapist-led treatments delivered via online means (eg, video conferencing and so on), cognitive training programs, blended treatments, and relapse prevention programs

inclusion: control group (waiting list, usual care, placebo, educational resources, or other nontherapeutic material)
